# Reply threading


Keep the conversation together. With our latest API updates, you can now thread related messages into the same email chain by simply adding a[unique thread reference ID](https://www.usewaypoint.com/docs/threading-replies) when[sending an email](https://www.usewaypoint.com/docs/api-reference/#send-an-email-with-a-template) API
